properties.verseOrder: v1 v2 v3 v4 v5 v6

verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
EKISEERA kye kituuse
-Ab'omu ggulu weebali;
Bonna batendereza nnyo
Nga bayimba bwe bati:

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Abasumba bwe baalaba
Bamalayika bali
Nga bayimba oluyimba
-Olwali -olw'okujaguza:

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Mu kiraalo bwe baagenda
Baamulaba omuto;
Bakkiriza nga ye Kristo,
Baamufukaamirira:
Ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda

verse.name: v6
verse.lines:
Naffe olw'okwagala kwe
Leero ka tuyimbe nnyo,
Tumutendereze -Omwana
Eyazaalibwa mu nsi:
Ekitiibwa kibe eri Katonda
